utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve only heard bits so far, but late morning—around 10 or 11—seems to work best for people. If you want, I can quietly ask who’s organizing and who can help with bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, please do—I just need to know who’s handling pickups and the exact storage address before I say yes to anyone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay—I’ll ask around quietly about who’s handling pickups and the storage address, and I’ll let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Kira, we’re starting with Mrs. Carter’s porch rail, then heading to the wobbly gate on Maple. I’ve got my tool kit and spare screws ready if you want to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is actually happening, right? I just need confirmation on the tools, volunteers, and where everything’s getting stored before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s happening—Leo’s bringing a level and wrench, I’ve got my drill, tool kit, and spare screws, and we’re staging everything at Mrs. Carter’s place before we head to Maple.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Jules, all I’ve heard is the supplies are coming in nicely, but we still need the date pinned down and people sorted for the roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’m still locking down the volunteer list and tool check now, and once that’s confirmed I’ll help pin the date with whoever’s on roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That makes sense, Jules—once you’ve got that list settled, do tell me, because half the block keeps asking me what’s firm and what still needs hands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes to this weekend, can you confirm who’s definitely available and whether the tools are covered, or should I check that with Faye?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still telling everyone about the repair drive, but I don’t have the firm availability or tool details yet—Faye’s probably the best one to check with for that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I'll check with Faye on availability and the tool list before I confirm anything for this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: If I’m doing the sheet, how many slots should I put down, and do you want them split by repair type?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Put down a handful of slots for now and split them by repair type if it keeps things tidy — I’m still out, but I’ll send along any firmer details as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: A handful means what, exactly—six, eight, ten? And if I split them, which repair types do you want listed on the sheet?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, Dane, I think it’s still the garage this weekend, but I should check in case Mara changed it again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry—I’m coming in late, but if it moved I’d rather know now; can you check whether we’re still at the garage, and I’ll head wherever the tools are going?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, yeah, I’ll check now, but last I heard it was still the garage for Saturday. If Mara changed it again, I’ll let you know before you head over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school drop-off and pickup—late morning, around 10:30, works best for me. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Late morning works great—how about 10:30, and I’ll add you to the list while I lock in everyone’s pickup times and jobs?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, 10:30 works for me—I'll swing by after drop-off, and I'll text you if school pickup timing changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Uli — I’m still on board for the repair drive, and I can start by sorting the donated tools and spreading the word to neighbors this week.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara—that would help a lot. I’m starting with the fence out back tomorrow morning, so if you can handle the tools and word-of-mouth this week, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, Uli—I’ll sort the donated tools and start letting neighbors know this week so you can focus on the fence tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s stick to the plan, Sam: get every repair onto one clear list today, and tomorrow morning by the mailboxes we’ll set the order and assign jobs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me — I’ll pull together one clear list today, and tomorrow morning by the mailboxes we can set the order and hand out jobs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Sam—that keeps it orderly. Once you’ve got the list together, bring it by this evening so we can make sure the urgent fixes are plainly marked.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand that we still need extension cords and work gloves, but Mara’s the one with the full list if you want the latest.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check with Mara for the latest list, and I can bring extension cords and a pair of work gloves if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps a ton, thanks—those were the two things I kept hearing we were short on, so that should really help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—let’s match volunteers to each stop first, and then we’ll see if we need to borrow any extra tools before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Right, let’s go stop by stop and note who’s assigned at each location, then we can see where the gaps are before we count tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect—I've got the route sheet here, so let’s start with Maple Street and make sure every stop has enough hands before we look at the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it’s still by the garage, but if Mara changed it again, holler at me. I’ll grab my toolbox from the shed and come help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—garage unless Mara moves it again. I’m waiting on the time, but I’ll bring what I can once we hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good—just ping me when Mara confirms the time, and remind me what we’re collecting so I don’t show up with the wrong stuff.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, Vik, I think we’re still meeting by the garage this weekend, unless Mara changed it again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll keep telling everyone about the repair drive and mention the garage this weekend unless we hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds right—sorry, I should double-check the garage too, and I think we might still be short on hammers or extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal — I’m still on board for the repair drive, and I can start by spreading the word and collecting repair requests from neighbors this week.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d help a lot, Mara—please note which houses the requests come from, and I’ll match them to the volunteer stops once Jules brings the list by the mailboxes tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Opal—I’ll note each house with its repair request this week so you can match them up once Jules drops the list by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah—we’re still on, and I’m pulling the volunteer names together tonight so Opal can sort them by cluster tomorrow at the mailboxes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, Jules—send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep an eye out for Ira’s time and spot update.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good—I’ll send you the volunteer list tonight, and let me know as soon as Ira confirms the time and spot so I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane—I’m still out running errands, so if you hear any update on the repair drive, keep me posted, alright?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late to the loop, Ira, but last I heard they’ve got a few lamps and a bike already, and folks are sorting out tools and the drop-off spot. I’ll keep you posted if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear it’s moving along, Dane. I’m still out, so send me the time and spot too if that gets settled.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, and nails counted already, but we should still round up extra tarps before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but are we definitely on for this weekend, and has anyone actually confirmed the pickups, volunteers, and the storage address yet?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: As far as I know, we’re still on for the weekend, but I don’t have all the pickup and volunteer confirmations yet. I’m checking with folks this afternoon anyway, so I can pin down the storage address too and get you the full list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Gus, it’s coming together—Mrs. Calder dropped off spare tools this morning, and I heard Ben’s bringing lumber by after lunch, but we still need folks lined up for roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That helps a lot—between the spare tools and lumber, we’re in good shape on supplies. I can cover fence posts with my kit, and let’s see if we can round up one more steady hand for the roof patching.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s a relief, Gus—if you’ve got the fence posts covered, I’ll keep asking around for someone dependable on roof patching before Ben rolls in with the lumber.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times—what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye — I’m planning to start setup early and get the main repair drive going midmorning, so if you can come for a late-morning block after drop-off or even a shorter stretch before pickup, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late morning after drop-off works best for me, and I can stay until I need to head out for pickup. Send me the setup time and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s stick to the plan, Pia: finish the list today, then meet by the mailboxes tomorrow morning and take the porch rail and leaking tap first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, but before we lock that in, who’s handling pickups and where exactly are we storing everything once it comes off the list?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep that plain, Pia: Quinn can handle pickups, and we’ll stack everything in the shed by the mailboxes so it’s easy to find tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—let’s meet by the garage, and if you can, remind me what we’re collecting so I don’t show up with the wrong thing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: By the garage’s fine. We’re mainly collecting tools and any spare fence hardware—posts, screws, brackets, that sort of thing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, thanks—I’d have mixed that up for sure. I left my toolbox by the shed again, but I can still bring it over and help sort the screws and brackets.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve only heard bits so far, but Gus mentioned small practical fixes like bikes and lamps. Faye said late morning, around 10:30, would work best for her if that timing helps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That lines up with what I’ve been hearing second-hand—small practical fixes sounds right, and 10:30 gives me something concrete to pass along. I’m still hoping to confirm the full list with Mara if I catch her first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a good next step. If Mara confirms it, I can quietly ask around for folks who are handy with bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do an hour tomorrow morning—send me the time, and I’ll bring gloves and a drill.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo—I’ll send the mailbox meet-up time once I’ve messaged everyone, and I’ll add you down with gloves and a drill.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—send the time when you’ve got it, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rosa, are you handling follow-up with that maybe couple, and when will you have a firm answer?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I’m following up with them myself, and I should have a firm answer by tomorrow so I can keep the repair drive plans on track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—once you hear back tomorrow, send me the final count so I can set the sign-up sheet slots right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Sam—have you all got the list sorted yet, and where do you want me to jump in?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’re in good shape—Mara’s sorting the donated tools and Mina’s handling the sign-up sheet, so could you help me get the tool table organized?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely—I’ll get the tool table squared away now, and just give me a shout if you want me on repairs after that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Opal, can you confirm it’s actually set for this weekend and who’s covering pickups, tools, and the storage address before we count on it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—Saturday’s the target, and I’m staging check-in by the mailboxes; Jules is bringing the volunteer list, and I’m sorting coverage by house cluster, but I still need to confirm final tool runners and the storage address before I sign off on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still not fully confirmed yet then—can you let me know once the tool runners and exact storage address are actually locked in?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, who’s following up with those two maybe households, and when will we have a firm count?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m following up with those two households myself tonight, and I should have a firm count by tomorrow when I bring the volunteer list by the mailboxes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—if you’ve got the follow-up tonight, then tell me this: how many volunteer slots should I put on the sign-up sheet, and do you want them split by repair type?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Leo, I’m still on board for the repair drive—I can start by sorting the donated tools and letting neighbors know we’re collecting repair requests this week.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—sort the tools first and spread the word on repair requests this week; I’ll start with Mrs. Carter’s rail tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good—I’ll sort the donated tools today and let the neighbors know we’re gathering repair requests this week.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only caught bits of it second-hand, but last I heard we still needed extension cords and work gloves. Mara had the full list, so I’d still double-check with her if you can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, but before we promise anything, can we pin down who’s handling pickups and the exact drop-off/storage spot? Once that’s clear, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that’s the part I haven’t gotten straight yet either—I only heard the supply side second-hand. If I run into Mara or Cleo first, I’ll ask about pickups and the drop-off spot and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that, Bo. I’ll stop by this evening and put in a little.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Uli—that helps a lot. Just bring whatever you can this evening, and we’ll put it to good use.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright. I’ll come by after supper and keep it brief.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I confirm anything, can you tell me whether Faye’s still handling pickups and if the tool list’s been covered yet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Far as I know, Faye’s still on pickups, and I’ve got the basic tool list covered with my kit—if you want, I can double-check what else we might still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — before I pass anything along, can you double-check whether your kit covers the faucet and railing fixes specifically, so I know we’re not missing anything?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate the repair drive, but I need to plan around school drop-off and pickup—late morning, around 10:30, usually works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That works fine—10:30’s a good window, and right now the main gaps I’m tracking are extension cords and work gloves. If you can help around then, I’ll line up the supply check so we can see whether anyone can spare tarps too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, 10:30 works for me—I'll come by after drop-off and we can check on the cords, gloves, and whether anyone has tarps to spare.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rosa, from what I’ve heard, the repair drive’s gathering steam—Mrs. Calder brought spare tools, Ben’s supposed to haul in lumber after lunch, and we still need people lined up for roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful to hear, Tess—thank you for keeping tabs on it. I’m matching volunteers to each stop now, so if you hear of anyone who can handle roof patching or fence posts, please send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely, Rosa—I’ll keep my ears open and send anyone handy your way, and if I hear who’s finally locking down the schedule, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but I’m listening for any update on the repair drive—if I hear the start time or where it’s set up, I’ll pass it right along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I think it’s still by the garage, unless Mara moved it again. If you hear the start time, remind me—I’m trying not to forget the toolbox this time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Alright — if I hear the start time while I’m out, I’ll send it over, and I’ll mention the garage too in case it stays there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still hearing back, but I’ve already started the repair list and sent invites around so we can pin down who’s in fast.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps—Faye said late morning, around 10:30, would work best for her. If that fits what you’re hearing from everyone else, I can pass that along when I chat with folks.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—that lines up well, so let folks know we’re leaning toward 10:30 for now, and I’ll keep spreading the word and firm up the list today.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
